recipes.title: Sangria
recipes.description: 西班牙 Sangria (from an Orenji production video). Makes one pitcher.
ingredients: 雪碧 / Sprite 1 can (or 7 Up or soda water)
百蘭地或威士忌 / Brandy or Whisky 150ml
steps: Dice the orange, lemon, and apple and put them in a pitcher — this fruit base is essential.
Pour in the chilled red wine, brandy (or whisky), and Grand Marnier over the fruit.
Top up with Sprite (or 7 Up / soda water).
Let it steep: a few hours minimum for a lighter infusion.
For a stronger flavor, cover and chill in the fridge longer before serving.
